slot_scores.name: no_borrowing_cash_only
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the initial capital of 500,000 yuan the only source of funds available for investment, or can additional external funds be injected during the three-year period
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked about external funds/injections and later modeled cash-only investment, but did not explicitly ask whether borrowing or loans are allowed. This touches the funding-source issue without fully confirming the no-borrowing/cash-only constraint.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: No borrowing is allowed; total investment at each decision point is limited to currently available cash.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never explicitly confirmed whether borrowing is permitted. The earlier question only ruled out additional external funds being injected, which does not necessarily exclude loans.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 no-borrowing/cash-only hidden slot remained only partially resolved. It did not explicitly confirm that borrowing is prohibited.

summary: The agent asked several reasonable clarification questions, but it only partially addressed the no-borrowing/cash-only constraint and then silently assumed it in the READY_TO_MODEL summary.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
